seoDescription: Your space is already deciding how you live. A free first conversation, or a paid hour on the plan, with Petrina Salema in Vienna.
hook: Your space is already deciding how you live. Stop decorating around a life you didn't choose. Shape the room that holds how you want to rest, gather, and think.

projectOffer.title: Full project
projectOffer.body: A redesign of how a home or room operates. How a family or guests move through it, then layout, materials, sourcing, and styling.
projectOffer.note: A few residences a year. Most take one to three months, in person in Vienna, and remotely abroad.
projectOffer.finance: A quote comes after the first conversation. A deposit starts the project, then billing in stages until the last invoice.

jumpstartOffer.title: A paid hour on the plan
jumpstartOffer.body: Spend one hour on the plan. The changes that would matter most, and a clear next step when you leave.

quote.text: My daughter started calling her room the room from the fairy tale.

primaryCta.label: Let's see if this is a fit
